Product Details: The Xtra-Power 1200W Wet and Dry Vacuum Cleaner is a robust and powerful cleaning solution designed to handle both wet and dry debris with ease. Featuring a generous 35-litre stainless steel drum, this vacuum cleaner is built to tackle heavy-duty cleaning tasks in workshops, garages, construction sites, and homes alike. The durable stainless steel body ensures long-lasting performance, while the smooth-rolling castors allow effortless manoeuvrability across various floor surfaces. The comprehensive accessory kit includes a flexible suction hose, extension tubes, a floor brush, a crevice nozzle, and an angled connector, giving you the versatility to clean hard-to-reach areas with minimal effort. The ergonomic top handle makes transportation convenient and straightforward. Whether you are dealing with sawdust, debris, or liquid spills, this wet and dry vacuum cleaner delivers consistent, powerful suction to keep your space spotless. A reliable and versatile cleaning companion for both professional and domestic use.
